newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish central bank says growth phase starting.
newsitem.headline: Swedish central bank says growth phase starting.

text.p: The governor of Sweden's central bank, Urban Backstrom, said on Friday that the Swedish economy was now entering a growth phase.
Speaking on television station TV2, the head of the Riksbank said expansion was starting.
"We have to look forward to growth."
He also said there was no need to warn of overheating on the Swedish stock market.
"Regarding Sweden I think develpment is good. There is no need for me to make any type of comment on this type of question," he said.
"Much in the Swedish economy has started to go well, and an expansion is probably starting," he said.
